description: Test path traversal with encoding variants at multiple depths. Tries plain ../, URL-encoded %2e%2e/, double-encoded %252e%252e/, and null-byte/truncation bypasses. Returns results array with payload, status, length, contains_target per attempt, and vulnerable_payloads list. Side effects: Read-only GET requests. Sends ~32 requests.

url.description: URL with file parameter, e.g. https://target/image?filename=photo.jpg

name: path_traversal_test
